integrity: Explicit proof and reproducible exact arithmetic tests; no independent scientific audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact normalized arclength sampling on finite one-junction metric stars of degree at least three; does not establish robustness to noise, nonuniform measure, or arbitrary trees. The full Mémoli–Needham article was not accessible for exhaustive originality comparison.
title: Global inverse reconstruction of metric stars from one geodesic-distance law
